title: Sections on a quasi-compact normal Noetherian open are a finite product of normal domains
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] such that each stalk $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is an integrally closed domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Let $U\subseteq X$ be a quasi-compact open. There exist an integer $n\geq 0$ and commutative rings $B_i$ for $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, each an integrally closed domain, and a ring isomorphism $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)\cong\prod_i B_i$. The empty open is included, with $n=0$ and the zero ring.

proof.text: Restrict to the open subscheme S=U. Open immersions induce stalk isomorphisms, so S has normal domain stalks. The source-library instance IsLocallyNoetherian.locallyConnectedSpace makes S locally connected. Its connected-component quotient is discrete; since S is compact, this quotient is finite (Mathlib Topology.Connected.LocallyConnected). Reindex these clopen components by Fin n.

Each component is connected and locally Noetherian with domain stalks. The proved source-library theorem irreducibleSpace_of_isDomain_stalk (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Noetherian) makes it irreducible. Domain stalks give reducedness by Mathlib isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk, hence integrality. Its sections are a domain, and the proved isIntegrallyClosed_of_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk (WeilConjectures.Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.FunctionField) makes them integrally closed.

Restriction of sections to the components is a ring homomorphism. Uniqueness of gluing makes it injective. Every tuple of component sections is compatible: on different components the intersection is empty and its sections form the zero ring. Existence of gluing makes restriction surjective. RingEquiv.ofBijective and the open-subscheme topIso yield the asserted product equivalence. This proof also applies when the component index is empty.

lean.statement:
theorem normal_sections_finite_product {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
      IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (B : Fin n → CommRingCat.{u}),
      (∀ i, IsDomain (B i) ∧ IsIntegrallyClosed (B i)) ∧
      Nonempty (Γ(X, U) ≃+* ∀ i, B i)
